jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer, Graduate
jobs.description:
## About Aurelis Labs
Aurelis builds the guardrail layer that sits between enterprise applications and the language models they call. Banks and insurers use us to strip personal data out of prompts and to block unsafe completions before they reach a customer.

## The role
You will join the platform team as a graduate engineer and own services in our request path. This is backend work with language models in it, not research.

## What you will do
- Build Python services with FastAPI that scan prompts and responses for personal data and policy breaches
- Extend our detection pipeline (regex, spaCy, Presidio) and measure its precision and recall
- Compose agent workflows with LangGraph and keep their state durable across restarts
- Ship REST APIs that customer engineering teams integrate against, with tests and real documentation
- Store results in PostgreSQL and keep the query path fast under load

## What we are looking for
- A degree in computer science or similar, graduating in 2025 or 2026
- Strong Python; FastAPI or another async web framework
- An interest in LLM guardrails, prompt design and evaluation
- Comfortable with a relational database and with writing SQL by hand
- TypeScript is welcome but not required

## Working here
Hybrid, two days a week in our Shoreditch office. We sponsor UK work visas for graduate hires.

jobs.title: Graduate Machine Learning Engineer, Evaluation
jobs.description:
## Metrikon
We make the evaluation harness that AI teams use to decide whether a model change is safe to ship. Our customers run tens of thousands of graded generations a day through us.

## The role
You will work on the evaluation service: the scoring runners, the graders, and the reports that come out of them. Most of the code is Python.

## Responsibilities
- Write and maintain Python graders that score model output against a rubric, validated with Pydantic
- Build LLM-as-judge pipelines and measure how far they drift from human scores
- Keep the runner fast and cheap: caching, batching, token accounting per run
- Expose results through a REST API and a small Next.js dashboard
- Work with LangChain and LangGraph where orchestration is genuinely needed, and plain functions where it is not

## About you
- Graduating 2025 or 2026 in computer science, maths or similar
- Python to a good standard; you have written something real, not only coursework
- You understand prompting well enough to know when a bad score is the grader's fault
- Bonus: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, experience with open-source contributions

Fully remote within the UK, with a monthly team day in London.

jobs.title: Junior Backend Engineer (Python)
jobs.description:
## Northgate Health
We build the referral platform used by community health providers across England. Reliability matters more than novelty here: a dropped referral is a person who did not get seen.

## The role
A junior backend role on a small team. You will own endpoints end to end, from the migration to the deploy.

## What the job involves
- Python services using FastAPI, with PostgreSQL behind them
- Designing REST APIs and keeping them backward compatible for integrated partners
- Writing database migrations and worrying about them properly
- Docker images and a deployment pipeline you will be asked to improve
- On-call during business hours after your first six months, with support

## Requirements
- One to two years of Python, or a strong graduate portfolio with real users
- SQL and relational modelling: you can explain an index to a colleague
- Tests as a habit, not an afterthought
- NHS or health-data experience is a plus, not a requirement

Three days a week in our Southwark office.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer, Full-stack
jobs.description:
## Fieldline
Field-service software for independent trades: scheduling, quoting, invoicing. Twelve thousand small businesses run their week on it.

## The role
A broad graduate role across the stack. You will be in the TypeScript codebase most days and in Python occasionally.

## You will
- Build features in Next.js and TypeScript, from the form to the database row
- Write and review API route handlers, with PostgreSQL underneath
- Take Stripe billing work: subscriptions, proration, failed-payment flows
- Sit in on customer calls once a month, because the people using this will tell you what to build

## We are looking for
- A 2026 or 2025 graduate, any degree, with code we can look at
- TypeScript and React; Next.js specifically is a bonus
- Some back-end exposure: Node, Python, C#, anything where you have modelled data
- Clear writing, because a lot of the job is explaining a change to someone who is not an engineer

Two days a week in Clerkenwell.

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
## Vantor Systems
Document automation for insurance brokers. We extract structured data out of the PDFs that still run that industry.

## The role
A junior AI engineering role: prompt and pipeline work, not model training.

## Day to day
- Python services that call language models and validate what comes back with Pydantic
- Prompt engineering against a labelled set, with the accuracy numbers to prove a change helped
- Retrieval over customer document stores, and the chunking decisions that go with it
- FastAPI endpoints consumed by our .NET application layer

## About you
- Python, and a real interest in how LLMs behave rather than how they are built
- Some experience shipping something that called a model in anger
- Good with ambiguity: half this job is deciding what "correct" means for a given document

## Location
Hybrid in central Manchester, three days a week on site. We are not able to offer a London base or fully remote working for this role.

jobs.title: Graduate Data Engineer
jobs.description:

A retail group of nine brands. The data team serves buying, supply chain and finance.

## The role
A graduate data engineering role on the warehouse team.

## What you will do
- Build and maintain dbt models over our Snowflake warehouse
- Orchestrate pipelines in Airflow and keep the DAGs understandable
- Write a great deal of SQL, and review other people's

- Document datasets so analysts stop asking the team what a column means

- Numerate degree, graduating 2025 or 2026
- SQL you are confident in
- Some Python
- Interest in dimensional modelling; we will teach you the rest

Two days a week in our Victoria office.

jobs.title: Junior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:

We run the internal developer platform for a group of fintech companies. Four hundred engineers deploy through us.

## The role
A junior platform engineering role. This is infrastructure, not product.

Remote within the UK.

jobs.title: Graduate .NET Developer
jobs.description:
## Halbury
Portfolio accounting software for wealth managers. Our core product has been in production for nineteen years and our customers like it that way.

## The role
A graduate developer role on the core platform.

## What you will do
- C# and .NET 8 across a large existing codebase
- SQL Server: stored procedures, query plans, and the occasional archaeology
- Some Blazor on the newer screens
- Work to a specification agreed with a business analyst, and write the tests that prove you met it

## Requirements
- Computing or numerate degree, 2025 or 2026
- C# or Java from a course or a placement
- Relational database fundamentals
- An eye for detail: the numbers on these screens are somebody's pension

Five days a week in the City. We do not offer hybrid working for this role.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
## Orcadia AI
We train and serve domain-specific models for logistics forecasting.

## The role
A senior individual-contributor role on the modelling team, reporting to the Head of ML.

## What you will own
- Model architecture and training decisions for our forecasting family, end to end
- Distributed training across a multi-node GPU cluster, and the cost of it
- Mentoring three to four engineers and setting the technical direction for the team
- Representing the team in architecture review and to the executive

- Seven or more years of industry machine learning engineering, including at least two leading projects

Two days a week in King's Cross.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Payments
jobs.description:

Payments infrastructure for US marketplaces. We move about four billion dollars a year.

- Own the ledger and settlement services: correctness, idempotency, reconciliation

jobs.title: Graduate Civil Engineer

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:

We sell workforce-scheduling software to hospitality groups. Forty staff, growing fast.

An SDR role on a team of six, generating pipeline for our enterprise account executives.

- Eighty outbound calls and forty personalised emails a day
- Qualify inbound leads against our ideal customer profile and book discovery calls
- Keep Salesforce clean, because the forecast is built from it

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Causal Inference
jobs.description:
## Oakmere Analytics
We measure the effect of marketing spend for consumer brands, and we are unusually serious about whether the answer is actually true.

## The role
A data scientist role on the measurement team.

## What you will do
- Design and analyse geo experiments and holdout tests
- Build marketing mix models and defend the assumptions behind them
- Write a lot of R, and some Python for pipeline work
- Present uncomfortable findings to clients who were hoping for different ones

## Requirements
- MSc or PhD in statistics, econometrics or a closely related field, or equivalent applied experience
- Strong grounding in causal inference: difference-in-differences, synthetic control, Bayesian hierarchical models
- R to a professional standard; Python welcome
- SQL for getting at the data yourself

Two days a week in Shoreditch.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer, Payments
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Junior DevOps Engineer

jobs.title: Graduate AI Engineer
jobs.description:

We build document intelligence for Swiss private banks. Everything we process stays inside Switzerland, which shapes most of our engineering decisions.

A graduate AI engineering role in Zurich.

- Python services, FastAPI, deployed into a Swiss-hosted private cloud

- Personal-data detection and redaction before anything leaves a client boundary

jobs.title: Research Engineer, LLM Safety
jobs.description:
## Arbor Institute
A non-profit research institute working on the evaluation of language-model systems. We publish everything.

## The role
A research engineer role: you will be the person who makes the experiments actually run. This is an engineering job in a research group, open to strong early-career candidates as well as experienced engineers.

## What you will do
- Build evaluation harnesses in Python that run thousands of graded generations reproducibly
- Implement guardrail and jailbreak benchmarks, and argue about whether they measure anything
- Maintain the agent scaffolding our researchers use, including LangGraph-based multi-step runs
- FastAPI services and PostgreSQL for experiment tracking and result storage
- Co-author papers and release the code alongside them

## Requirements
- Strong Python; you write code other people can run six months later
- Hands-on experience with LLM application work: prompting, structured output, evaluation
- Comfortable reading a paper and turning it into a working experiment
- No PhD required. We have hired excellent people straight out of undergraduate study

## Nice to have
- Open-source contributions
- Experience with guardrail or personal-data detection systems

Two days a week in Bloomsbury.

jobs.title: Junior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
## Brennig Software
Case-management software for legal practices. Three hundred firms, and a release every two weeks.

## The role
A junior QA automation role on the quality team.

## What you will do
- Write and maintain end-to-end tests in Playwright and TypeScript
- Own the regression suite for two product areas and keep it honest about flakiness
- Exploratory testing on new features before they reach the suite
- Raise defects with the detail a developer needs to reproduce them
- Some API testing against our REST endpoints

## Requirements
- Some experience with a test automation framework, commercial or personal
- TypeScript or JavaScript basics
- Methodical: you enjoy finding the case nobody thought of
- Interest in CI: these tests have to run on every pull request

Fully remote within the UK, with quarterly team days in Bristol.
